AUMA, part-turn actuators SQ 05.2-SQ 14.2 / SQR 05.2-SQR 14.2 Control unit: electromechanical, operation instructions Y005.559/003 (PR00442/en/1.26): fitting the handwheel §5.2 p. 12, mounting on the valve with the coupling §5.3.1 pp. 13-15, end stops §10.1 p. 27, servicing §13 p. 41

body.name: Valve body
body.does: Holds the seat and the shaft between the pipe's flanges, the line's bolts round it; its neck carries the actuator.

liner.name: Seat (liner)
liner.does: A rubber ring lining the bore: the disc's edge presses into it to close the valve tight. It comes out last, squeezed into an oval.

disc.name: Disc
disc.does: Turns a quarter of a turn on its shaft: across the bore it closes the valve, edge-on it opens it. Held on the shaft by taper pins.
disc.material: Stainless steel or coated ductile iron

shaft.name: Shaft
shaft.does: Carries the disc and turns it; its top end takes the actuator's coupling.

packing.name: Shaft bushing and packing
packing.does: Guide the shaft in the neck and seal it, under the packing gland.

actuator.name: Electric part-turn actuator
actuator.does: A motor and a worm gear that turn the shaft a quarter of a turn between its end stops, with its limit and torque switches. It is one part here: its maker's service opens it.

coupling.name: Coupling
coupling.does: Joins the actuator's output to the shaft's top: it goes on the shaft first and the actuator over it.

indicator.name: Position indicator
indicator.does: A disc on top that turns with the valve: along the pipe is open, across it closed.

handwheel.name: Handwheel
handwheel.does: Works the valve by hand when the motor is not running.

text: The body sits on the bench, its bore across.
why: Bray takes the valve out of the line and lays it down with the taper pins' nuts up, the disc on wooden blocks, before the shaft is driven out.

text: Squeeze the seat into an oval and work it into the body's bore, its shaft holes on the body's.
needs: body
The seat lines the body's bore.
The body stays.

text: Push the disc into the seat, its hub's bore on the shaft holes.
needs: liner
The disc closes in the seat: fit the seat first.
Take the disc out before the seat.

text: Drive the shaft down through the neck and the disc's hub, and fit the taper pins and their nuts.
why: The disc's pins and the bottom plate under the shaft are not drawn: the pins come out before the shaft, the bottom plate and its thrust bearing before the pins.
needs: disc
The shaft goes through the disc's hub: put the disc in first.
Drive the taper pins and the shaft out before the disc comes out.

text: Slide the bushing and the packing over the shaft into the neck and fit the packing gland.
needs: shaft
The packing seals round the shaft: put the shaft in first.
The packing comes out with the shaft.

text: Set the actuator onto the neck's top flange over the coupling, the valve and the actuator both at the same end position.
why: Isolate the actuator's supply before anything is undone. Its end stops are set again after it is mounted.
needs: packing
Fit the gland before the actuator goes on.
Take the actuator off first.

text: The coupling joins the actuator's output to the shaft's top.
why: AUMA fits the coupling on the shaft first and lowers the actuator over it.
needs: actuator
The coupling is the actuator's output: set the actuator on first.
It comes off with the actuator.

text: The position indicator turns with the actuator's output, on its top.
needs: actuator
The indicator is the actuator's: set the actuator on first.
It comes off with the actuator.

text: Put the handwheel on its input shaft and fit its retaining ring.
needs: actuator
The handwheel is the actuator's: set the actuator on first.
Take the handwheel off once the actuator is off the valve.

text: Fit the actuator's mounting bolts and tighten them crosswise.
needs: actuator
The bolts hold the actuator's flange: set it on first.
Take the mounting bolts out first.
